title: 13 Best Herbal Creams For Hypothyroidism
intro: Herbal creams for Hypothyroidism are topical preparations made from natural herbs and plants that are applied directly to the skin to help regulate thyroid function and alleviate symptoms associated with hypothyroidism. These creams often contain a blend of herbs such as Ashwagandha, Bladderwrack, and Guggul, which have been traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to support thyroid health and balance. The benefits of using herbal creams to treat hypothyroidism include reduced inflammation, improved energy levels, and enhanced thyroid hormone production. Examples of herbal creams that can be used to treat hypothyroidism include Thyroid Support Cream by NOW Foods, Bladderwrack Cream by Nature's Bounty, and Ashwagandha Cream by Jarrow Formulas, which contain bioactive compounds that help to stimulate thyroid function and promote overall well-being.

preparations.preparation_desc: Curcuma longa creams, derived from the rhizome of Curcuma longa, a plant commonly known as turmeric, have been studied for their potential in treating hypothyroidism. The anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties of Curcuma longa creams help to regulate thyroid function and improve overall thyroid health. Bioactive constituents such as curcumin, demethoxycurcumin, and bisdemethoxycurcumin in Curcuma longa creams have been shown to inhibit the production of thyroid peroxidase, an enzyme involved in thyroid hormone synthesis, thereby helping to treat hypothyroidism. The benefits of using Curcuma longa creams to treat hypothyroidism include improved thyroid function, reduced inflammation, and enhanced overall well-being.
